title: Cells and molecules
description: Review a few building blocks of biology and chemistry.
subject: Science

lessons.title: Start here
lessons.markdown:
# From molecules to cells

Water is **H₂O**: two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

Human cells have specialized structures. The nucleus stores most genetic information.

tests.title: Cells and molecules practice
tests.description: A short original practice set with immediate explanations.

questions.prompt: Which structure contains most of a human cell’s genetic material?
questions.explanation: The nucleus holds most DNA in human cells. Mitochondria also contain a small amount.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: Water contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
